mapper.select: SELECT distinct a.drug_name_chinese, a.drug_type_chinese, a.gene, a.rs_id, a.genotype,a.annotation_chinese, a.evidence, a.annotation_type FROM omics.nkb_chemical_drug_annotation_vw a join this_chemical_marker_vw b on a.allele_id = b.mapped_allele_id join nkb_do_tree t on t.id = a.cancer_do_id where a.annotation_type = 'Efficacy' and b.report_id = #{report_id} and t.parent_id = #{primary_cancer_id} union SELECT distinct a.drug_name_chinese, a.drug_type_chinese, a.gene, a.rs_id, a.genotype,a.annotation_chinese, a.evidence, a.annotation_type FROM omics.nkb_chemical_drug_annotation_vw a join this_chemical_marker_vw b on a.allele_id = b.mapped_allele_id where a.annotation_type = 'Efficacy' and b.report_id = #{report_id} and a.cancer_do_id = 162 order by evidence,drug_type_chinese, drug_name_chinese desc;

SELECT distinct a.drug_name_chinese, a.drug_type_chinese, a.gene, a.rs_id, a.genotype,a.annotation_chinese, a.evidence, a.annotation_type FROM omics.nkb_chemical_drug_annotation_vw a join this_chemical_marker_vw b on a.allele_id = b.mapped_allele_id where a.annotation_type= 'Efficacy' and b.report_id = #{report_id} and a.cancer_do_id not in (select id from nkb_do_tree where parent_id = #{primary_cancer_id}) order by a.evidence,a.drug_type_chinese, a.drug_name_chinese desc;
